title: Figure 17: Distribution of All Sightings by Observer Location, All Years and Each Year
description: Stacked percentage bar chart with bars for "All years" and each year 1947–1952, divided by observer location: In car, In plane, In bldg., Other, Outdoors and Location not stated. The y-axis is "Per Cent of All Sightings Reported", and totals appear above each bar (3201, 117, 205, 164, 306, 160, 2018). Dashed lines connect category boundaries between years. Caption: "FIGURE 17 DISTRIBUTION OF ALL SIGHTINGS BY OBSERVER LOCATION FOR ALL YEARS AND EACH YEAR"; drawing A-7495.
